chars.ACHRAF: ACHRAF: a slim young Moroccan man about 25, short black hair, thin moustache, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and light blue jeans, white sneakers
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a confident Moroccan woman about 35, long wavy auburn hair, wearing a bright red blazer over a black top, big gold hoop earrings
